title: Hide Away Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Hide Away is an adorable carriage house located just a short walk to the beach, pools, tennis courts, fitness center and children's park.
description_expanded: Description* Construction Notice - Third-party construction is occurring on an adjacent lot across from this residence and may be visible or audible during permitted hours. In Seaside, Florida, construction hours are Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection team at 1-855-411-1557 to inquire on construction details.117 SAVANNAH STREET1 KING BEDCharming Studio Carriage House in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaHide Away is an adorable studio carriage house located adjacent to the main Drift Away home, offering a prime Seaside, Florida location just one block from the beach and half a block from iconic Seaside Avenue. Perfectly positioned near the adult pool, tennis courts, pickleball courts, and the park, this centrally located retreat places you steps from everything Seaside has to offer.Bright, Renovated Studio with Modern KitchenThis second-floor walk-up studio has been fully renovated and features a thoughtfully designed open layout ideal for a relaxing beach getaway. The fully equipped kitchen includes quartz stone countertops, a four-burner electric stovetop with oven, full-size refrigerator, microwave, and bar seating for four—perfect for casual meals or morning coffee before heading to the beach.Comfortable Living and Sleeping SpaceThe open studio living and sleeping area features a king bed, side table, dresser, and flat-screen TV, all surrounded by windows that fill the space with natural light for a bright and airy coastal feel. Double doors open to a private balcony with seating for two, offering a peaceful spot to unwind after a day exploring Seaside.Updated Bath and Outdoor AmenitiesHide Away includes a renovated full bathroom with a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower. Outdoor amenities include a private charcoal grill and a rear outdoor shower—ideal for rinsing off after sandy beach days.Shared Laundry and Walkable Seaside LocationAll Drift Away and Hide Away units share one washer and dryer conveniently located under the stairwell at Hide Away. With over 35 shops and restaurants just steps away, Hide Away is the perfect Seaside vacation rental for a quick weekend escape or a cozy beach retreat in the heart of town.*This cottage may also be rented with the main Drift Away cottages for additional space. Drift Away (5 bedroom), Drift Away Main (4 bedroom), Drift Away Suite (1 bedroom). This cottage shares a driveway and street parking with the other Drift Away cottages. One vehicle parking pass is allotted for 1 bedroom cottages. The shared parking for this unit is shared with Drift Away 5BD, or Drift Away 4 and Drift Suite rented at the same time; guests will have first come/first serve driveway parking. However, guests will be given a Seaside Town Council parking pass that will allow for self-parking along Savannah Street as long as no other driveway is blocked and or in the overflow parking available at Smolian Circle."* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESSeaside Private Residential Beach at Savannah Pavilion176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessCharcoal grillShared washer and dryer located under the stairwell at Hide Away and shared by all Drift Away unitsAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued for this one-bedroom cottageGolf carts are considered a car and are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside unless pre-approved for medical needsNo pets allowedSTR23-001913
